description: Polymarket prediction markets: the most traded open markets by 24-hour volume, or the markets matching a search, each with outcome prices (implied probability), best bid and ask, last trade, day change, volume, liquidity, end date, slug and CLOB token ids. Use to get the odds on an election, sports, crypto or news event, or to find a market before reading its order book. Example: q=bitcoin. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

closed.description: true for resolved or closed markets instead of open ones

q.description: Optional search, e.g. bitcoin, election, fed rates; without it the top markets by 24h volume
